metadata.scenario: A patient calls to reschedule their cancelled appointment due to a conflicting doctor's visit. The receptionist rebooks for next Wednesday at 2 PM. Polite, straightforward call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Michael Brown. I need to reschedule my father's appointment. Of course, Michael. I can help with that. What day was the original appointment? It was for last Wednesday, but he had a conflicting doctor's visit. No problem. Let's find a new time for him. When would you like to reschedule? How about next Wednesday at 2 PM? Let me check… Yes, we have availability then. Great! Can you confirm that for me, please? Absolutely. I’ll book your father for next Wednesday at 2 PM. Thank you! I really appreciate it. You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Well, I'm also looking for help with his wound care and medication management. We can certainly assist with that. For wound care management, it typically runs between $75 and $95. And for medication management? That service is priced between $65 and $80. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Can I schedule those services too? Yes, we can set those up. Would you like to discuss a specific day for those services? Maybe start with the wound care for next week too? Sure! Would you prefer to have that done on the same day as the appointment at 2 PM? Yes, that would be perfect. Alright, I will schedule the wound care for next Wednesday at 2 PM as well. Thank you so much for your help! You’re very welcome! Just to confirm, your father's appointment is set for next Wednesday at 2 PM for both services. That’s right. Should I expect someone to call me before the appointment? Yes, our care coordinator will reach out to you a day before to confirm everything. Perfect. I appreciate your assistance today, Margaret. No problem at all, Michael! If you have any more questions, feel free to call us anytime. I will. Thank you again! Thank you for choosing CareFirst Home Health! Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
